subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept this waited A2A artifact-suppression boundary for message-tool mirror and inter-session transcript rows before merge?
rationale: The patch is focused and covered, but it deliberately changes which transcript rows can drive visible A2A replies, and CI cannot prove every live channel history shape.

options.title: Accept Boundary
options.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the PR targets the observed duplicate visible-message failure and keeps reverse sessions_send and compaction replay in separate related work.

options.title: Require Live Channel Proof
options.body: Keep this PR open and ask for a redacted live WhatsApp or equivalent channel run if deterministic Gateway/qa-channel proof is not enough.

options.title: Defer To Broader A2A Plan
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want the mirror, reverse-send, requester return-path, and compaction duplicate fixes coordinated together.

recommendation.title: Accept Boundary
recommendation.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the PR targets the observed duplicate visible-message failure and keeps reverse sessions_send and compaction replay in separate related work.
